name: bluechip API health
description: [bluechip] Requests, latency and errors by route, live streams and the chain-read proxy.

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `axiom.histogram` == "count"
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `axiom.histogram` == "count"
| where `http.response.status_class` == "5xx"
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.active_streams`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using last
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.rpc_proxy.calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `axiom.histogram` == "count"
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `http.route` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `axiom.histogram` == "count"
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `http.response.status_class` using sum

charts.name: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 by route (ms)

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `http.route` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `axiom.histogram` == "count"
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `error.type` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`http.server.active_streams`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.rpc_proxy.calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `rpc.method` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.rpc_proxy.calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

query.apl:
declare query_parameters (env:string = "production");
['${TRACES_DATASET}']
| where tostring(column_ifexists('resource.deployment.environment', '')) == env
| extend span_kind = tostring(column_ifexists('kind', '')), span = tostring(column_ifexists('name', '')), ms = todouble(column_ifexists('duration', 0)) / 1000000
| where span_kind == 'server'
| summarize p95_ms = percentile(ms, 95), n = count() by span
| order by p95_ms desc
| take 20

declare query_parameters (env:string = "production");
['${LOGS_DATASET}']
| where tostring(column_ifexists('resource.deployment.environment', '')) == env
| extend level = toupper(tostring(column_ifexists('severity_text', '')))
| where level in ('ERROR', 'FATAL')
| project _time, level, body = tostring(column_ifexists('body', '')), trace_id = tostring(column_ifexists('trace_id', ''))
| order by _time desc
| take 50
